commit_scope: Keep the observed running revision through shallow-checkout build selection and cache unchanged native source across application releases.
evidence_refs: The deployed image label was 0b99ef368840, but the shallow VPS checkout lacked that commit. The release discarded its actual running revision and selected diff_base=f90847554849, rebuilding only API although the original release also changed web and pulse.
The observed running revision now remains the diff base; the existing unavailable-diff path selects all services.

Kernel-builder previously consumed COHERENCE_SOURCE_SHA before COPY/compile, invalidating native cache on every parent release. It now consumes only COHERENCE_FORM_SHA; the final API image still binds both revisions.
Docker source metadata is excluded from COPY inputs; native source identity and bundle attestation remain the authorities. fkwu runtime/JIT source is unchanged.

local_validation.summary: Read the actual release trace and shallow-checkout condition; inspect changed Docker configuration and shell syntax/diff.

ci_validation.summary: The production image build and serving revision supply the focused observation.

e2e_validation.expected_behavior_delta: A failed previous release cannot hide missing service changes, and unchanged native source remains reusable across parent revisions.
test_flows: Observe production build scope and public API/web identity.

phase_gate.blocked_reason: Authorized rollout supplies the release observation.
